title: Breaking Free from the Swampland of Impossible Universes through the DESI Portal
summary: The persistent challenge of creating stable de Sitter vacua within string theory undermines the observational validity of the $Λ$ cold dark matter (CDM) model. This difficulty suggests that the concordance model of cosmology, characterized by a constant dark energy $Λ$, may reside in the swampland of inconsistent quantum gravity theories rather than the string landscape of consistent ones.
